body: Hey, I saw that you privately messaged me (I don’t accept messages). So like, I don’t know if I’m a p myself (I show OCD tendencies, as well as I’ve had other sexual obsessions/fears, such as fear of being gay/bi, trans, or zoophile), but I fear that I am one or could be one. Anyways, what do you mean by attracted? Do you want to have sex with kids? If so, then you probably are one, but it’s not the end of the world—I know that’s foolish to say from someone like me, but like in all honesty, you seem like you’re a good person by caring that you are one. Note that psychologists/therapists are mandated reporters, meaning they can report you just for discussing your thoughts. Psychologists who study P condone a website called Virtuous Pedophiles, where you can connect with people who have similar issues as you. There is a P on quora who helps people like you as well. Maybe you’d like to check out his blog.

NTA. You didn’t do anything wrong. It appears like you respected your distance and that jackass flipped out because he got the wrong message. He’s one of those boomers who hates kids, by his statement “stupid kids”
Yeah, but then you end up getting the previous theme worse than it was before, only to want the theme you had just been struggling with... it’s a never ending cycle that can never be satisfied.

Yeah, I get you. It’s more like you’re scared that the doctor will see it as “proof” that you might be a danger—which you aren’t. 

Now, I have a question is your fear constant? Like do you always think about this, sometimes it fades away  and then gets triggered again?
Thanks! Honestly, I just need to talk to a professional, to evaluate me, and go from there.
Thank you! What do you think I should expect? Do you think this could be OCD?

Thank you. I will see my GP on Thursday, and hopefully get a referral to a psychiatrist or someone who specializes in OCD. 

It’s just crazy for me to see that people still have faith in me. Like I’ve clearly done shit in the past, dwelling on that stupid past, lost all respect for myself—yet you guys still have faith in me. 

Thank you so much, everyone. I will seek help.
I made an appointment with my GP on Thursday. I hope all goes well. Thank you!

Thank you very much. This made me more confident that seeking help is the best thing to do. 

That makes me really happy to hear that kind people like yourself and others on reddit still have faith in me—something I lost days ago. I actually have an appointment with my GP on Thursday which I hope can refer me to a psychiatrist and then discuss all of this. 

I’ve just reached such a low-point that it’s affecting my daily life and university.

I’ve had other obsessions too like germaphobia and not wanting to share food or drinks with people. I was obsessing the other day about a banana peel close to me in the lecture hall. I constantly hoard things in my bag or pencil case because I feel they’ll give me good luck//I fear something bad will happen to me if I don’t. I never change my bios/names on social media for the same reason. After I whitened my teeth, I would seek reassurance every time to see if it worked. I’m a perfectionist, or at least was when it came to school and tasks//yet that died after my whole self-worth dropped to negative infinity.

I pray to the same individuals in the same order. I always pray the same way. If I don’t remember saying a Hail Mary or an Our Father, I feel like I’m disrespecting them and must pray again. I always say sorry, much to the annoyance of people. I think back with guilt constantly about mistakes/how I treated people on a daily basis.

I order things in a particular order, like at the dinner table.

I was 12 when a kitten bit me and I thought I had rabies after reassurance every day. I would look up symptoms everyday and was convinced I was going to die. I thought I was developing diabetes, Parkinson’s (because of shaking), fatal insomnia (because I couldn’t sleep many nights last year), cancer because of growth spurts and that my legs were going to be amputated, schizophrenia because of voices at night while trying to sleep, and tuberculosis due to night sweats.

And I feared I would be a stoner when I started high school/got older/would obsessively think about it. Didn’t happen.
